subject: afn
title: AFN.------TH.CONT.
description: Diagram in NYM-15, on the page where Braxton argues that 'the realness of disunification must be viewed as a factor that has lessened the impact—and potential—of everything it touches' regarding the creative musicians' community of the sixties. (C)AFN (affinity negation) is crossed with TH-CONT (thrust continuance). The structural pairing is sharp: affinity negation (the rejection of an alignment) is crossed with thrust continuance (the continuing momentum of a creative line). The path from the subject bends at CUL-TF-S (cultural transfer shifts): AFN → CUL-TF-S → TH-CONT (the crossing). (R)ATTN (real attraction) hangs from the first stretch. From the second stretch hang (C)STF (the concept of source transfer), APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions), C-CONT (composite continuance) and, by a *dashed* line, (C)GRAD (concept of gradualism). From the GRAD line, AFTF (affinity transfer) → POST (postulation), with PART (participation) joined to the POST line by a *dashed* line. In Braxton's legend a dotted line amplifies some aspect of the main concept it is connected to.
